items.title: [MacOS] ld: can't link with bundle (MH_BUNDLE) only dylibs (MH_DYLIB) file '/opt/local/lib/lua/5.1/lpeg.so' for architecture x86_64

labels.name: build
labels.description: building and installing Neovim using the provided scripts

labels.name: has:workaround
labels.description: issue is not fixed but can be circumvented until then

items.body:
### Problem

The following problem occurs during building:

```
:info:build ld: can't link with bundle (MH_BUNDLE) only dylibs (MH_DYLIB) file '/opt/local/lib/lua/5.1/lpeg.so' for architecture x86_64
:info:build clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```

The LPeg library in its Makefile comes in a `.bundle` extension instead `.dyld` on macOS.  Based on this issue, I think that the bundle needs to be loaded using the dyld API. For example: https://stackoverflow.com/a/54012960

Full logs: [main.log](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/files/11840801/main.log)
Neovim version: 12c2c16acf7051d364d29cfd71f2542b0943d8e8

### Steps to reproduce

The build uses the standard Release build with disabled USE_BUNDLED (=OFF) option. However, changing this option does not solve this issue. The MacPorts build file for neovim:

https://github.com/macports/macports-ports/blob/master/editors/neovim-devel/Portfile

### Neovim version (nvim -v)

12c2c16acf7051d364d29cfd71f2542b0943d8e8

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

no

### Operating system/version

macOS 13.4

### Terminal name/version

kitty 0.28.1

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-kitty

### Installation

MacPorts (build from repo / maintainer)
